Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Nikhil - 8 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Kavya - 9 years, daughter
Look: yellow frock, two plaits
3. Pallavi - 34 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
4. Aarav - 8 years, friend
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
5. Riya - 10 years, friend
Look: red frock, a clip in her hair

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The garden - flower beds, a mango tree

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Nikhil stands in the living room. Kavya, Pallavi and Aarav stand near him.]

Aarav: "Aunty, what's the plan today?"

[Nikhil puts on his school uniform.]

Kavya (surprised): "And then?"

[Kavya applies kajal to her eyes.]

Kavya: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Kavya puts on red lipstick.]

Kavya: "That's easy."

[Kavya puts a bindi on her forehead.]

Kavya (softly): "Oh wow!"

Scene 2: The garden - Day

[Nikhil stands in the garden. Pallavi and Riya stand near him.]

Riya: "What a nice place."

[Nikhil waters the plants.]

Pallavi: "Oh wow!"

[Nikhil chases a butterfly in the garden.]

Nikhil: "That was such a fun day!"
